ui.setup.config.error.unavailable: Error: the configuration service could not complete the operation.
ui.setup.config.error.network: Error: no connection to the configuration service.
ui.setup.config.error.timeout: Error: the configuration request timed out and was cancelled.
ui.setup.config.error.invalid_response: Error: the service answered with an unexpected shape; nothing was stored.
ui.setup.verify.title: Heading of the verification checklist panel.
ui.setup.verify.lead: Explains that each item shows observed evidence and that a postponement is not a pass.
ui.setup.verify.mode: Label before the installation mode the checklist was evaluated in.
ui.setup.verify.next: Guidance back to configuration when an item fails.
ui.setup.verify.no_evidence: Shown for a checklist item that reported no observed evidence.
ui.setup.verify.unknown: Shown before any verification has run in this session.
ui.setup.verify.status.passed: Checklist status: the item was observed as ready.
ui.setup.verify.status.failed: Checklist status: the item failed its observed check.
ui.setup.verify.status.pending: Checklist status: the item has not been decided yet.
ui.setup.verify.status.postponed: Checklist status: the item was deferred, which never counts as ready.
ui.setup.verify.status.risk: Checklist status: the item is an accepted risk, not a pass.
ui.setup.verify.item.database_ready: Checklist item label for the database being reachable during final verification.
ui.setup.verify.item.migrated: Checklist item label for the schema being migrated during final verification.
ui.setup.verify.item.worker_ready: Checklist item label for the work queue being alive during final verification.
ui.setup.verify.item.storage_ready: Checklist item label for storage being prepared during final verification.
ui.setup.verify.item.origin_valid: Checklist item label for the public origin being allowed during final verification.
ui.setup.verify.item.session_valid: Checklist item label for sessions being configured during final verification.
ui.setup.verify.item.ai_explicit: Checklist item label for the AI provider being decided during final verification.
ui.setup.verify.item.appearance_decided: Checklist item label for appearance being decided during final verification.
ui.setup.verify.item.backup_policy_decla: Checklist item label for the backup policy being declared during final verification.
ui.setup.verify.item.smtp: Checklist item label for outgoing mail (SMTP) during final verification.
ui.setup.verify.item.monitoring: Checklist item label for supervision during final verification.
ui.setup.verify.item.external_search: Checklist item label for external search during final verification.
ui.setup.verify.item.external_engines: Checklist item label for external engines during final verification.
ui.setup.verify.item.integrations: Checklist item label for integrations during final verification.
ui.setup.boot.title: Heading of the fixed fallback page when the application cannot start.
ui.setup.boot.body: Fixed explanation shown when the application cannot start; never includes the host error text.
ui.setup.boot.retry: Button that reloads the page after a start failure.
ui.setup.verify.back: Button that returns from the verification checklist to the configuration sections.
